blocks.content: Practice reading a finished dashboard on Grafana Play. Identify what a dashboard monitors and whether its panels support a clear goal, find a panel's query and data source, interpret its unit, and identify which panels are resource measurements and which are service measurements.

Use the finished dashboards on Grafana Play. The examples include demo data; don't treat their values as operational limits. Inspect settings without saving changes.

Resources:
- [Grafana dashboard best practices](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/visualizations/dashboards/build-dashboards/best-practices/)
- [Dashboards](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/visualizations/dashboards/)
- [Panels and visualizations](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/visualizations/panels-visualizations/)
- [Configure standard options](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/visualizations/panels-visualizations/configure-standard-options/)
